input_boundary.private_runner_boundary: Full task/arrival stream retained only by authorized order runner; selector/query/sampler receive allowlisted projection. Sampling cannot consume monitor or terminal fields.

probabilities.representation: parse saved original native probability numeric lexemes using Decimal; never displayed 4-decimal text
probabilities.duplicate_actions: group exact pick_item_id + canonical pose + oriented_size_mm; group score=max of member native probabilities, not sum; retain member map and original forced candidate
probabilities.ties: exact Decimal equality of saved native values only; provider internal tie resolution UNKNOWN
probabilities.rank: not physical probability or causal confidence

near_top.definition: g(a)=(p_max-p_a)/p_max; admitted when g<=epsilon; exact group g==0 separately
near_top.selection_program: From training public baseline projections, for each complete non-singleton decision find smallest strictly-positive gap g among distinct actions. q=nearest-rank 25th percentile of these gaps. epsilon=min(q,1/10). If no positive gaps, use epsilon=0 and exact-only. If p_max<=0 reject decision.

relative_ceiling.basis: operational definition of near-top (at least 90% of top native score), a conservative design convention not a measured optimal cutoff or physical confidence

near_top.freeze_deadline: JM1-C1 public sampling receipt BEFORE any suffix dispatch; algorithm fixed JM0-B and parser/range constructs verified JM1-B1

point_selection.required_reference: original selected exact action must be in the registered top/near set; otherwise skip with ORIGINAL_OUTSIDE_LAYER
priority: both same-box and cross-box available then same-box then cross-box
point_selection.selection_information: public decision only, no terminal or monitoring result
point_selection.same_box: same exact item ID; pose/yaw differs; position and orientation subtypes retained
point_selection.cross_box: different exact item ID; public attribute contrast recorded
point_selection.alternative_choice: within registered layer choose highest saved native score, then ascending exact action digest; at most one each class
point_selection.no_category: record missing class; do not substitute another category
point_selection.singleton: not a fork point; no API

branches_and_repeats.repeat_selection: task-order round robin over OPENING then NONEMPTY strata, distinct source groups first, then ascending task/decision digest; freeze concrete first <=4 points BEFORE first suffix result
branches_and_repeats.new_original_reference: re-run original forced action with SAME no-memory Jev continuation per repeat
branches_and_repeats.provider_seed: freeze actual support or UNSUPPORTED; never invent common random numbers

payload.claim_scope: If sampling is top ties/near-top only, findings restricted to this registered observed-native-probability stratum; no high-confidence-error/all-decision claim.
